Extracts keywords, author, viewport, generator, theme-color, robots, lang, dir metadata

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Crawlberg\Crawlberg;
$engine = Crawlberg::createEngine(null);
$url = "https://example.com";
$result = Crawlberg::scrape($engine, $url);
var_dump($result->statusCode);
var_dump($result->getMetadata()->title);
var_dump($result->getMetadata()->canonicalUrl);
var_dump($result->getMetadata()->keywords);
var_dump($result->getMetadata()->author);
var_dump($result->getMetadata()->viewport);
var_dump($result->getMetadata()->generator);
var_dump($result->getMetadata()->themeColor);
var_dump($result->getMetadata()->robots);
var_dump($result->getMetadata()->htmlLang);
var_dump($result->getMetadata()->htmlDir);
```
